source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 567 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 567 was established by Ordinance No. 24126, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 8, 1999. Ordinance No. 24126 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 567 is established on property generally bounded by Beckley Avenue and Cumberland Street on the west, Ninth Street on the north, Storey Street on the east, and Jefferson Boulevard on the south. The size of PD 567 is approximately 5 acres. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 567A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted on the Property are the following Institutional and Community Service uses:

(1) Child-care facility.

(2) Community service center.

(3) Public or private school. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to

additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard. Minimum front yard is as shown on the development plan.

(b) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yard is as shown on the development plan.

(c) Floor area. Maximum floor area is 108,000 square feet.

(d) Height.

(1) Except as provided below, maximum structure height is 45 feet.

(2) If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion of a structure may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A- 4.408(a)(2) may project through the residential proximity slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less.

(e) Lot coverage.

(1) Maximum lot coverage is 50 percent.

(2) For purposes of lot coverage, the Property is considered to be one lot.

(3) Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(f) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(g) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use, provided, however, that not less than 118 off-street parking spaces must be provided. Consult Division 51A-4.300 for regulations governing off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.110. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Existing landscaping is shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 567B).

(b) Prior to the issuance of a building permit for any new structures in the area identified as future Building Area on the development plan, a landscape plan must be submitted to the building official for an artificial lot that complies with the following landscape provisions:

(1) For purposes of this subsection, an artificial lot is the land area that includes the footprint of any new structure and 10 feet around the structure.

(2) The aggregate land area of all artificial lots may not exceed 50 percent of the total land area on the Property. For purposes of this paragraph, the Property is considered to be one lot.

(3) Landscaping must consist of a foundation planting strip for all building facades facing a public street or alley and one street tree for each 50 feet of frontage on a public street. Street trees required by this paragraph must be planted within 30 feet of the projected street curb and within the street frontage of the artificial lot.

(c) Prior to the completion of a surface parking area in the area identified as Future Parking and/or Playground Area on the development plan, a solid landscape screening hedge, a minimum of 30 inches in height and approved by the building official, must be provided along the northeastern line of this area as shown on the development plan.

(d) Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.111. SIGNS.

Except as provided below, signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII.

(1) Detached non-premise signs are prohibited.

(2) The monument sign shown on the development plan may have exterior dimensions of 5 feet by 50 feet, but the message area on the monument sign may not exceed 100 square feet in area confined to the three panels shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.112. FENCING.

A fence with a maximum height of six feet is permitted in the front yard for the area identified as Future Parking and/or Playground Area on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-567.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 567 is located on Zoning Map No. L-7. (Ord. Nos. 24126; 25163)
